description: This source file implements the BufferParser class and related classes for parsing media buffers, extracting metadata, codec data, and protection information for media segments in a GStreamer-based media pipeline.

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing media buffers and extracting media segments, including protection metadata and codec data.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing audio-specific buffer data.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing video-specific buffer data.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Main method to parse a GstSample and GstBuffer into a MediaSegment, extracting timestamp, duration, and associated metadata.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption and protection metadata to a media segment based on buffer and structure information.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Extracts codec data from GstStructure and attaches it to the media segment.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (AudioBufferParser)
methods.description: Parses audio-specific buffer data, extracting sample rate and channel count.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (VideoBufferParser)
methods.description: Parses video-specific buffer data, extracting width, height, and framerate.
